policy.below_minimum: Treat performance metrics as descriptive economic outcomes only; do not claim reliable performance inference.
policy.minimum_met: Bare interpretive minimum reached; retain substantial uncertainty and avoid strong validation claims.
policy.preferred_met: Preferred event-count threshold reached; inference still remains conditional on the observed market regimes.

planning_estimate.method: Linear extrapolation from observed entries per completed daily observation.
planning_estimate.use: Planning only; this is not a forecast, deadline, or guarantee that qualifying entries will occur.
